device_timing_model.source: ADI UG-570 Rev. A, Table 51 (public): DATA_CLK/FB_CLK source-synchronous LVDS topology; tDDRX/tDDDV min 0.25 ns, max 1.25 ns; tSTX min 1.0 ns; tHTX min 0 ns. Board skew/margin below remain project assumptions pending PN/tap-window measurement.

board_assumptions.basis: Offline conservative model only. It is deliberately not recorded as a measured FMC/FMCOMMS3 PVT timing bound.
board_assumptions.required_board_validation: At 16 MHz DATA_CLK and 200 MHz IDELAYCTRL reference, sweep every RX lane through tap values 0..31 using AD9361 PN data. Require a contiguous zero-error window of at least 8 taps per lane, record the selected midpoint and temperature, then replace this model with measured min/max values.
